text: Let me start by loading the pages.
Angular app, app-root empty. Check for errors.

I couldn't test either page, so every criterion on both is NEEDS_REVIEW. I'm not reporting any PASS, FAIL or DNA, because I have no evidence for them.

Both pages are an Angular app, and its `<app-root>` stayed empty in my browser. After about 20 seconds the page had no visible text, no headings, no links and no form fields. The console showed no errors. The only failed request was the app's silent single sign-on check to `auth.sciencecloud.nasa.gov`, which returned `net::ERR_FAILED`. The app probably waits on that check before it renders, and it never finished here. The forum page showed the same empty result.

The only parts of the page I could inspect were an empty `app-root`, stylesheet links, scripts and one iframe, which is probably the sign-on iframe. None of that bears on these criteria.

A person should re-test both pages in a browser where the sign-on check completes. They should also confirm whether users who are blocked from that check, such as those with third-party cookies or iframes disabled, get a blank page. If so, that is a separate problem, and WCAG 2.0 has no criterion in this list that covers it directly.
